items: Visual judgments apply to the proof the gate reads, and the retained bundle keeps every gate review's result
Spent review rounds read `Review rounds spent: N issues open` and point at Hold
After a restart, running reviewers are reattached, a run whose machine is offline stays held, and finished native sessions no longer fail the run
Findings from a blocked fix's re-review stay continuable, and the gate re-binds a slot still on the run's branch
Runner state no longer lives inside slot checkouts, and a reviewSequence's first row runs the pipeline review
